name: @pipeworx/mcp-nyt

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search of New York Times news articles. Returns headlines, abstracts, sections, bylines, and URLs. Example: search_articles({ query: "artificial intelligence", sort: "newest" })

query.description: Search query — keywords or phrase to search New York Times articles for.

page.description: Result page (0-indexed, 10 results per page). Default 0.

begin_date.description: Earliest article date in YYYYMMDD format, e.g. "20240101" (optional).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NYT API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: top_stories
tools.description: Get current New York Times top stories for a section (home, world, business, technology, science, health, sports, arts, etc.). Returns titles, abstracts, bylines, and URLs. Example: top_stories({ section: "technology" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NYT API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: books_bestsellers
tools.description: Get a current New York Times bestselling books list (e.g. hardcover-fiction, hardcover-nonfiction, combined-print-and-e-book-fiction). Returns rank, title, author, description, publisher, and weeks on list. Example: books_bestsellers({ list: "hardcover-fiction" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NYT API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: movie_reviews
tools.description: Search New York Times movie reviews. Optionally filter by query or critics picks. Returns title, summary, byline, publication date, and URL. Example: movie_reviews({ query: "dune", critics_pick: true })

query.description: Search query — movie title or keyword (optional).

critics_pick.description: If true, only return reviews flagged as NYT Critics’ Picks (optional).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own NYT API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nyt forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nyt pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
